request: Review narrowly for concrete correctness defects in pinned-cut SQLite backup and atomic no-overwrite filesystem publication. Focus on whether source transaction pins a valid cut; standalone destination close/journal handling; sync/link ordering; lost reply and collision behavior. Local 24 scenarios pass including 4 new tests with process exits after one copy step, before link, after link and after directory sync. Process exit tests are not power-loss evidence. No in-place restore, migration, authenticated backup or semantic history fsck is claimed. Return concise findings that could change implementation, distinguishing bugs from explicit trusted-directory/platform/physical-durability limits. Do not demand an expanded platform.
